The main takeaway from our work is that
a Nash equilibrium seeking strategy is developed for N coalition non cooperative multi agent systems, in which the coalitions act as the VPs and the agents therein act as the DMs.
the Nash equilibrium can be achieved in the N coalition game by the agents' local interactions, without requiring the agents' access to the information of the other agents' local objective function.

, by utilizing the proposed seeking strategy, the agents in the N coalition game can reach a consensus in the coalitions' local objectives while simultaneously achieving the Nash equilibrium in the N coalition noncooperative game.
